name: Human_Aligned_Bench
description: Human_Aligned_Bench evaluates how well language models align with human preferences and instructions by providing prompts paired with human-annotated responses. It is used to measure preference correctness and instruction-following quality via direct human comparisons of model outputs. The dataset supports evaluating trade-offs between helpfulness, harmlessness, and factuality in open-ended generation.
reputation: A niche but growing resource within the alignment and safety evaluation community, primarily used in research settings.
